category_edits.rationale: Use jointly trained diagonal compatibility h^T diag(1 + 0.1*tanh(a))e in all four category models. Zero initialization preserves initial dot-product scores, while bounded weights allow dimension-specific compatibility. Training and prediction share the same parameter; the predictor writer already imports the updated SASRec class and loads its state dict. Backbone, inputs, history readout, loss, optimizer and epoch cap remain unchanged.
